turns.instruction:
Build the attached 4.2 m cantilever column in OpenSees, fixed at its base. The lower 0–2.1 m segment is 450 by 450 mm and the upper 2.1–4.2 m segment is 350 by 450 mm. Top loads are global Fx=+30 kN and Fz=-600 kN. Report global top Uz and Ux and base support Rz and My, including signed units and case D.
Use the stated OpenSees engine for every computable changed state. First-order linear elastic analysis; self-weight, P-delta, rigid diaphragms, rigid offsets and construction stages are off. Preserve all fields not explicitly changed. Report every requested signed value with node/member, global direction, unit, case/combination, turn, model state and traceable . Rz denotes the vertical support reaction Fz. Retain original cases and evaluate every listed combination separately. Resolve essential missing or contradictory inputs before reporting new numerical results.

Reverse only the 30 kN X-direction load: final Fx=-30 kN; retain Fz=-600 kN. Preserve the 2.1 m section boundary, both sections, their local axes, material and total height. Reanalyze the current model using first-order elasticity. Report global top Uz and Ux and base support Rz and My, including signed units and case D.
